title: Accordion
description: Accordion with accessible presentation and local state.
usage: Import Accordion or AccordionMultiple from @rightui/ui and control expanded through change. Use AccordionOptions or AccordionMultipleOptions for disabledItems and collapsible. Pass every prop explicitly and forward the reduced-motion preference.

description: Alert with accessible presentation and local state.
usage: Import Alert, AlertDialog from @rightui/ui. Supply content and required properties as shown in the example.

title: Alert Dialog

title: Aspect Ratio
description: Aspect Ratio with accessible presentation and local state.
usage: Import AspectRatio from @rightui/ui and supply ratio plus slotted content. Use AspectRatioFrame(ratio, radius) for an explicit corner radius. Ratios must be positive; nonpositive values fall back to a square. Copy the packaged assets/card directory into your app assets when using the example cover.

title: Attachment
description: Attachment with accessible presentation and local state.
usage: Import Attachment(id, name, metadata, content, status, remove) for the legacy wrapper. Use AttachmentOptions for explicit size, orientation, imageSource, cardWidth, previewHref, reduced, copyable and copyValue, alongside the legacy props. Compose groups and previews with the public Attachment parts. Empty previewHref opens the built-in content preview; a nonempty value is a real link. Retry is a caller-owned AttachmentAction that updates status and content. Pass every prop explicitly; image examples use external image URLs.

title: Avatar
description: Profile images with initials, status badges, overlapping groups and an account menu.
usage: Use AvatarFrame for an image and fallback, then compose AvatarStatus or AvatarBadge inside it. Group profiles with AvatarGroup and AvatarGroupItem. Sizes are sm, default and lg. AvatarMenu adds a keyboard-accessible account menu.
keyboard: AvatarMenu: Enter, Space or ArrowDown opens the menu; ArrowUp opens at the last enabled item. Arrow keys, Home, End and typing move focus. Enter or Space selects an item. Escape closes and returns focus to the avatar.

title: Badge
description: Badge with accessible presentation and local state.
usage: Import Badge(label, variant) for the legacy wrapper, or BadgeWithOptions(label, variant, options) with BadgeOptions(icon, trailingIcon, href, fill, ink, direction, invalid). Supply every options field explicitly; empty strings select no icon/link or default colors. Use BadgeContent for slotted content, BadgeIcon for named SVG icons and BadgeSpinner(reduced, label) for status. BadgeContent requires variant, href, fill, ink, direction, invalid and iconPosition. Variants are default, secondary, destructive, outline, ghost and link; primary and success remain accepted.

title: Breadcrumb
description: Breadcrumb with accessible presentation and local state.
usage: Import Breadcrumb(id, labels, choose) for legacy callbacks. BreadcrumbOptions also requires hrefs, separator, label and direction; ancestor entries without hrefs keep choose. Compose real links and a noninteractive current page with the public Breadcrumb parts. BreadcrumbResponsive(id, entries, width, reduced, label, direction) uses MenuLinkEntry(id, label, href), unique IDs and an empty final href; it shows hidden ancestors in a dropdown at width >= 768 or a Drawer below 768. DropdownMenuLinks requires id, label, entries, reduced, customTrigger and direction. Pass every prop explicitly; native hosts must declare the example link destinations.

title: Bubble
description: Bubble with accessible presentation and local state.
usage: Import Bubble(id, body, align, variant, collapsible) for the legacy wrapper. Use BubbleOptions to also supply reactions, reduced, initialCollapsed and previewLength explicitly. Compose grouped content, links, buttons, reactions and popovers with the public Bubble parts; pass every required prop. Variants are default, secondary, muted, tinted, outline, destructive and ghost; primary remains a legacy alias. Use MarkdownDocument and parseMarkdown inside BubbleContent for Markdown.

title: Card
description: Card with accessible presentation and local state.
usage: Import Card for a titled container or compose the public CardFrame, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardAction, CardContent and CardFooter parts. The Options components add explicit size, spacing, imageTop, direction, divided, edgeToEdge and connectedFooter choices as applicable. Resolve cardSpacing(size, spacing) once and pass that spacing to each part. Copy the packaged assets/card directory into your app assets for the example cover. Pass every Options prop explicitly.

title: Carousel
description: Browse cards by swiping, using the arrow keys or pressing the navigation buttons.
usage: Use Carousel for text slides, or compose CarouselTrack and CarouselSlide around custom content. Set fullWidth to reach the edges of the parent. Set showControls to false to place CarouselControl anywhere, passing the track ID as target and sharing its selection and change action.

title: Chart
description: Inspect bar, line, pie, radar and radial charts with sample data.
usage: Import ChartPoint with Chart(id, points) or AreaChart(id, points); use SeriesPoint and ChartSeries with LineChart(id, label, points, series, showLegend, reduced). PieChart and RadialChart use ChartSlice data; RadarChart uses SeriesPoint and ChartSeries. ChartOptions, AreaChartOptions and LineChartOptions expose explicit tooltip, formatting, cursor, legend and direction choices as applicable; ChartOptions also supports stacked bars. Compose SeriesValuesTooltip or SeriesValuesTooltipOptions and SeriesLegend or SeriesLegendOptions from the same series configuration. Pass every Options prop explicitly and forward reduced where required.

title: Checkbox
description: Select individual options or a group of items.
usage: Import Checkbox for a labeled boolean control, CheckboxControl for a caller-composed label, or CheckboxMixed for checked="true", "false" or "mixed". Keep state in the parent and update it through change(bool). Use CheckboxField to associate helper text or validation with the control, or make the entire option card selectable.

title: Code Block
description: Display source code with syntax tokens, highlighted lines, diffs and useful file actions.
usage: CodeBlock keeps its existing props and adds a line-wrap toggle with clearer diff styling. Use CodeBlockAdvanced for tokenized content, highlighted or added/removed lines, a custom starting line, maximum height and optional file export. CodeToken contains text and tone; CodeLine contains tokens and variant. Supported tones are plain, keyword, string, function, number, comment, type and property. Line variants are default, highlighted, added and removed. Supply tokenized lines from your data or build tooling; language labels the code and does not run a parser. The example uses Shiki-generated tokens with light and dark theme colors. Copy and Download always use the original code string. Keep that string and the tokenized lines in sync. An empty lines array falls back to the code string. The export uses the platform save flow.
keyboard: Tab focuses Wrap lines, Download code when enabled, Copy code and the scrollable code region. Enter or Space activates the focused action. Wrap lines exposes its pressed state.

title: Drawer
description: A draggable bottom panel with compact content, floating surfaces and scroll-to-expand pages.
usage: Use Drawer or DrawerAdvanced for an internally managed bottom panel. DrawerContent adds a controlled snapPoint/changeSnap pair and DrawerOptions for detached surfaces, optional controls, backdrop opacity, bounce and scroll behavior. Compose fixed content with DrawerInset and DrawerFooter around a DrawerBody. Each scroll body has its own compact inset; avoid duplicating it. Scroll-to-expand animates to full available height while preserving the same controls. See docs/DRAWER.md for all required props and the scroll/resize boundary.
keyboard: On the resize handle: ArrowUp/ArrowDown select the next/previous stop, Home/End select the smallest/largest stop, and Enter/Space cycle stops. Escape dismisses. Tab/Shift+Tab remain within the handle, close button and supplied focusIds.

title: Message Scroller
description: A bounded conversation viewport that follows streamed replies while preserving the reader’s position.
usage: Use MessageScroller for its legacy composer, MessageScrollerTranscript or MessageScrollerTranscriptStart for a virtualized transcript with an external composer, or MessageScrollerRichViewport for caller-owned rich rows. Provide a bounded height and handle send and history in the caller.

usage: Use NavigationMenu for one trigger, or NavigationMenuSections with NavigationMenuSection for grouped links. Choose list or grid layout, use empty entries for direct links, and pass the reduced-motion preference.
keyboard: Arrow keys move between triggers and links. Enter or Arrow Down opens a section. Escape closes the panel and returns focus to its trigger.

title: Popover
description: Popover with accessible presentation and local state.
usage: Use Popover for a self-contained panel. For controlled panels, pair PopoverTrigger with PopoverFrame: controls names the panel id, expanded mirrors its state, and press opens or closes it through your action. The trigger shares DisclosureButton variants and sizes while declaring the popover relationship for outside-click handling.
keyboard: Enter or Space activates the trigger. Escape closes the panel and returns focus to its trigger. Clicking outside closes the panel; interacting inside keeps it open.

title: Resizable
description: Accessible resizable panels with horizontal, vertical and right-to-left layouts.
usage: Compose ResizablePanelGroup, ResizablePanel and ResizableHandle. Set orientation to horizontal or vertical, dir to ltr or rtl, and withHandle to show or hide the grip. Pass the same orientation and dir to the group and its handle. Store the first panel percentage in state and update it with change. Each example has independent state.
keyboard: Arrow keys resize by 1%; Shift + Arrow resizes by 10%. Horizontal arrows follow the visual direction in RTL. Home/End select the bounds, Enter restores the initial size and Escape cancels an active drag. A hidden grip remains draggable and keyboard accessible.

keyboard: Tab and Shift+Tab stay inside the modal. Escape, the close button and the backdrop dismiss it. Focus returns to the opening control.

title: Toast
description: Stacked notifications with smooth directional motion, actions and loading states.
usage: Keep ToastViewport mounted and pass ToastMessage records newest first. Choose top-left, top-center, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-center or bottom-right. Supply a gated root clock for automatic dismissal and asynchronous updates; remove a message in dismiss(id) after its exit completes. Loading messages remain until updated or dismissed. Toast keeps its original single-notification API.
keyboard: Tab reaches the front notification actions. Focus or hover expands the stack and pauses automatic dismissal. Escape closes the focused notification.

keyboard: Hover, tap or focus the trigger to show the hint. Escape dismisses it; moving focus away closes it.

title: Trace
description: Follow reasoning, tool results and sources with compact, expandable activity traces.
usage: Use Trace for a simple list of steps. Compose TraceFrame, TraceLine, TraceDisclosure and TraceSource for rich activity with controlled disclosure, per-step icons and running, pending or error states. Pass the reduced-motion preference to the composable primitives. The preview uses a local scripted clock: Replay demonstrates the UI and does not execute commands or contact an AI service. Its source includes the injected clock used by the demo.
keyboard: Tab moves between disclosures, source links and Replay. Enter or Space toggles the focused disclosure. Closed content is hidden from keyboard navigation.
